sources.title: GitHub - gfmei/PerLA: The official repository of [CVPR2025] PerLA ...
sources.snippet: The examples use local model directories under outputs/models/. Obtain the weights and tokenizers for facebook/opt-1.3b and CH3COOK/bert-base-embedding, and adjust --vocab and --qformer_vocab to their locations. A detector-only checkpoint initializes training; evaluation requires a trained PerLA captioner checkpoint.
